critical_code_review_comments: [GOOD] useReveal fix is minimal and correct — threshold:0 + rootMargin '0px 0px -5% 0px' fires as soon as the top of the element enters viewport (ideal for tall grids). The 1.2s setTimeout failsafe that force-adds .in to any :not(.in) whose top is within innerHeight+200px is a defensive belt-and-braces pattern — non-intrusive, no layout churn.

[NIT] The failsafe only runs once at t=1.2s. If a user is extremely slow to scroll on an older device where IntersectionObserver is throttled, elements far below viewport are still handled by the live observer — that's fine. But if a client later mounts .rl-reveal dynamically (lazy content), those will not be observed. Current app has no such case, so safe.
[NIT] Prior-iteration carryovers (non-blocking): (a) 5 exhibitions.js seeded image URLs still 404 → letter placeholder; (b) Singapore/Malaysia label overlap at narrow widths.

context_for_next_testing_agent: Reveal fix is solid across mobile (390x844), tablet (820x1180), and desktop (1920x1000). 16 domestic cards render immediately without tab click. If a future iteration modifies useReveal, re-test by (a) loading mobile 390x844, (b) immediately evaluating document.querySelector('.rl-city-grid').classList.contains('in'), expecting true within 1.5s.
rca_of_the_issue: ROOT CAUSE (user-reported): IntersectionObserver threshold:0.12 — for the 16-card grid (~7000px tall on mobile 390px width), 12% visible = 840px had to enter viewport before reveal fired, which only happens after significant scroll. Since .rl-city-grid starts with opacity:0 (via .rl-reveal default) and transitions to opacity:1 only on .in class, the grid stayed blank. Clicking a tab triggered a component re-render which must have side-effect-triggered the observer. FIX APPLIED by main agent: threshold:0 + negative rootMargin on bottom (-5%) so reveal fires on first pixel of intersection; plus 1.2s failsafe that sweeps any .rl-reveal:not(.in) within viewport+200px. VERIFICATION: grid.classList.contains('in')=true and opacity=1 on initial mobile load without any tab click.
